title: Discrete-Time Vector Autoregressive Model (center = FALSE)
text: measurement model given 𝒚i,t=𝜼i,t\begin{equation}   \mathbf{y}_{, t}   =   \boldsymbol{\eta}_{, t} \end{equation} 𝒚i,t\mathbf{y}_{, t}, 𝜼i,t\boldsymbol{\eta}_{, t} random variables. dynamic structure given 𝜼i,t=𝜶+𝜷𝜼i,t−1+𝜻i,t,with𝜻i,t∼𝒩(𝟎,𝚿)\begin{equation}   \boldsymbol{\eta}_{, t}   =   \boldsymbol{\alpha}   +   \boldsymbol{\beta}   \boldsymbol{\eta}_{, t - 1}   +   \boldsymbol{\zeta}_{, t},   \quad   \mathrm{}   \quad   \boldsymbol{\zeta}_{, t}   \sim   \mathcal{N}   \left(   \mathbf{0},   \boldsymbol{\Psi}   \right) \end{equation} 𝜼i,t\boldsymbol{\eta}_{, t}, 𝜼i,t−1\boldsymbol{\eta}_{, t - 1}, 𝜻i,t\boldsymbol{\zeta}_{, t} random variables, 𝜶\boldsymbol{\alpha}, 𝜷\boldsymbol{\beta}, 𝚿\boldsymbol{\Psi} model parameters. , 𝜼i,t\boldsymbol{\eta}_{, t} vector latent variables time tt individual ii, 𝜼i,t−1\boldsymbol{\eta}_{, t - 1} represents vector latent variables time t−1t - 1 individual ii, 𝜻i,t\boldsymbol{\zeta}_{, t} represents vector dynamic noise time tt individual ii. 𝜶\boldsymbol{\alpha} denotes vector intercepts, 𝜷\boldsymbol{\beta} matrix autoregression cross regression coefficients, 𝚿\boldsymbol{\Psi} covariance matrix 𝜻i,t\boldsymbol{\zeta}_{, t}. alternative representation dynamic noise given 𝜻i,t=𝚿12𝒛i,t,with𝒛i,t∼𝒩(𝟎,𝑰)\begin{equation}   \boldsymbol{\zeta}_{, t}   =   \boldsymbol{\Psi}^{\frac{1}{2}}   \mathbf{z}_{, t},   \quad   \mathrm{}   \quad   \mathbf{z}_{, t}   \sim   \mathcal{N}   \left(   \mathbf{0},   \mathbf{}   \right) \end{equation} (𝚿12)(𝚿12)′=𝚿\left( \boldsymbol{\Psi}^{\frac{1}{2}} \right) \left( \boldsymbol{\Psi}^{\frac{1}{2}} \right)^{\prime} = \boldsymbol{\Psi} .

title: Discrete-Time Vector Autoregressive Model (center = FALSE)
text: Covariances psi theta estimated using LDL’ decomposition positive definite covariance matrix. decomposition expresses covariance matrix Σ\Sigma 𝚺=(𝑳+𝑰)diag(Softplus(𝒅uc))(𝑳+𝑰)′,\begin{equation}   \boldsymbol{\Sigma} = \left( \mathbf{L} + \mathbf{} \right) \mathrm{diag} \left( \mathrm{Softplus} \left( \mathbf{d}_{uc} \right) \right) \left( \mathbf{L} + \mathbf{} \right)^{\prime}, \end{equation} : 𝑳\mathbf{L} strictly lower-triangular matrix free parameters (l_mat_strict), 𝑰\mathbf{} identity matrix, 𝒅uc\mathbf{d}_{uc} unconstrained vector, Softplus(𝒅uc)=log⁡(1+exp(𝒅uc))\mathrm{Softplus} \left(\mathbf{d}_{uc} \right) = \log \left(1 + \exp \left( \mathbf{d}_{uc} \right) \right) ensures strictly positive diagonal entries. LDL() function extracts decomposition positive definite covariance matrix. returns: d_uc: unconstrained diagonal parameters, equal InvSoftplus(d_vec), d_vec: diagonal entries, equal Softplus(d_uc), l_mat_strict: strictly lower-triangular factor.
code: sigma <- matrix(   data = c(1.0, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0),   nrow = 2,   ncol = 2 )  ldl_sigma <- LDL(sigma) d_uc <- ldl_sigma$d_uc l_mat_strict <- ldl_sigma$l_mat_strict I <- diag(2) sigma_reconstructed <- (l_mat_strict + I) %*% diag(log1p(exp(d_uc)), 2) %*% t(l_mat_strict + I) sigma_reconstructed #>      [,1] [,2] #> [1,]  1.0  0.5 #> [2,]  0.5  1.0

title: LDL' Decomposition of a Symmetric Positive-Definite Matrix — LDL
text: Performs LDL' factorization symmetric positive-definite matrix \(X\), $$X = L D L^\top,$$ \(L\) unit lower-triangular (ones diagonal) \(D\) diagonal.

title: LDL' Decomposition of a Symmetric Positive-Definite Matrix — LDL
code: LDL(x)

title: LDL' Decomposition of a Symmetric Positive-Definite Matrix — LDL
text: x Numeric matrix. Must symmetric positive-definite.

title: LDL' Decomposition of a Symmetric Positive-Definite Matrix — LDL
text: list components: l_mat_unit Unit lower-triangular matrix \(L\). l_mat_strict Strictly lower-triangular part \(L\). d_mat Diagonal matrix \(D\). d_vec Vector diagonal entries \(D\). d_uc Unconstrained vector \(\mathrm{softplus}(d\_uc) = d\_vec\). x Original input matrix. y Reconstructed matrix \(L D L^\top\). diff Difference x - y.

title: LDL' Decomposition of a Symmetric Positive-Definite Matrix — LDL
text: function returns unit lower-triangular factor \(L\) diagonal factor \(D\). strictly lower-triangular part \(L\) also provided convenience. function additionally computes unconstrained vector d_uc softplus(d_uc) = d_vec, using \(\mathrm{softplus}^{-1}(y) = \log(\exp(y) - 1)\) stable back-transformation.

title: LDL' Decomposition of a Symmetric Positive-Definite Matrix — LDL

title: Softplus and Inverse Softplus Transformations — Softplus
text: softplus transformation maps unconstrained real values positive real line. useful parameters (e.g., variances) must strictly positive. inverse softplus transformation recovers unconstrained value positive input.

title: Softplus and Inverse Softplus Transformations — Softplus

text: x Numeric vector matrix. Input values transformed.

text: Softplus(): numeric vector matrix strictly positive values. InvSoftplus(): numeric vector matrix unconstrained values.

title: Softplus and Inverse Softplus Transformations — Softplus
text: Softplus(x) = log(1 + exp(x)) InvSoftplus(x) = log(exp(x) - 1) numerical stability, functions use log1p() expm1() internally.
